offers_products.reason: Manufactures chlorine, caustic soda, epoxy resins and Winchester ammunition.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from manufactured chemicals and ammunition; no main service offering is described.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Winchester ammunition is sold through retailers to hunters and sport shooters, who choose the brand.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Chlor alkali, vinyls and epoxy go to industrial manufacturers; ammunition goes to retailers, law enforcement and military.

recurring_revenue.reason: Chemicals are repeat-order commodity inputs bought continually by industrial customers; ammunition is also repurchased by retailers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Chlor alkali, vinyls and epoxy track construction and industrial activity; ammunition demand is discretionary, so buyers can cut purchases.

big_ticket.reason: Chemicals like chlorine, caustic soda and epoxy, plus ammunition, are bought repeatedly in small-to-moderate lots.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured chemicals and ammunition, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main chemical customers are large industrial producers (vinyls, epoxy, water treatment, pulp); Winchester also sells to government and military.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates many chlor alkali, epoxy and ammunition plants; heavy manufacturing needing ongoing capital investment.

notes: Winchester ammunition also sells to consumers via retailers; the larger chemical business sells mainly to industrial buyers.
